_doc: The fleet mesh mounts the Sync tab's Mounted subpage lists: the storage surfaces the WireGuard mesh actually serves to a phone. A mount is a label plus enough to reach it — the host alias, its mesh address, the protocol and the auth source. ADDRESSES ARE WIREGUARD MESH ADDRESSES ONLY (10.0.0.x) AND HOST ALIASES. No public IP is ever declared here, and the public edge (oci-analytics) is never the route: wg-public has no DNS and the mesh is the only network these surfaces are declared to exist on.
_doc_status: status is the fleet-side truth. ok = a current host serves this surface on wg0. unreachable = the surface is named in the architecture but a current host does not serve it; the subpage MUST show the specific reason instead of an empty box or a hollow green (#292).
_doc_off_mesh: OFF-MESH IS AN ERROR, NOT AN EMPTY LIST. If WireGuard is down none of these surfaces answer; the subpage says so in the section footer rather than pretending the list is empty.

mounts.label: Gitea API (repos feed)
mounts.reach: mesh-only; the public git.diegonmarcos.com domain sits behind two-factor auth this app cannot complete
mounts.auth: unauthenticated for the public mirrors (confirmed live by the SuperApp's GiteaFeed); push needs an ssh key this device does not carry
mounts.notes: Gitea org `diego` mirrors every non-fork GitHub repo except cloud-vault; the Git subpage renders the same family on both remotes.

mounts.label: Gitea SSH
mounts.notes: The way a mesh client actually pushes to the mirrors.

mounts.label: Filebrowser
mounts.reach: public via the edge AND on the mesh
mounts.notes: The browser-facing file manager over /opt/containers/filebrowser data.

mounts.label: Photoprism originals (WebDAV)
mounts.reach: wg_only — off the mesh the origin answers 403
mounts.auth: would need photoprism credentials on the phone
mounts.reason: The photoprism container ships PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_WEBDAV=true, so there is NO WebDAV endpoint to mount; the declared mount is refused by the origin itself.
mounts.notes: The originals volume itself exists (see drive-rclone-jobs.json) but is served as a fleet-side bind mount, not a device-facing mount.

mounts.label: WireGuard hub
mounts.reach: hub of the mesh, the only route into every other host
mounts.notes: Not a storage surface; the reason the storages above exist at all.
